description: Bootstrap Next.js 14 project with TypeScript, Tailwind CSS, and complete design system foundation. Install all required dependencies (zustand, axios, react-hook-form, zod, @heroicons/react, date-fns). Configure tailwind.config.ts with exact design system colors (primary #166534, secondary #65A30D, accent #F59E0B, background #F8FAF5), Inter font, and 8px spacing scale. Create foundation files: lib/constants.ts (API base URL, route constants, color tokens), types/index.ts (Product, Category, User, Order, Cart, ApiResponse interfaces matching Prisma schema), lib/api/client.ts (Axios instance with JWT interceptor reading from localStorage), app/layout.tsx (Inter font, metadata), app/globals.css (Tailwind imports, CSS variables for design system).
steps: Run 'npx create-next-app@latest frontend --typescript --tailwind --app --eslint --no-src-dir' in c:\Users\admin\Kuperfume to bootstrap Next.js 14 app in frontend/ subdirectory
Install additional dependencies: cd frontend && npm install zustand axios react-hook-form zod @heroicons/react date-fns @hookform/resolvers clsx tailwind-merge

Configure frontend/tailwind.config.ts: extend theme with colors (primary.DEFAULT: '#166534', secondary.DEFAULT: '#65A30D', accent.DEFAULT: '#F59E0B', background: '#F8FAF5', surface: '#FFFFFF'), fontFamily (sans: ['var(--font-inter)', 'system-ui', 'sans-serif']), spacing 8px grid (xs:4px, sm:8px, md:16px, lg:24px, xl:32px, 2xl:48px, 3xl:64px)

Create frontend/lib/constants.ts with API_BASE_URL='http://localhost:3001/api/v1', ROUTES object (HOME:'/', MARKETPLACE:'/marketplace', LOGIN:'/auth/login', etc.), COLORS object matching design system

Create frontend/types/index.ts with interfaces: User (id, email, firstName, lastName, role: 'CUSTOMER'|'SELLER'|'ADMIN', emailVerified, sellerProfile?), Product (id, name, slug, description, price, unit, categoryId, sellerId, rating, reviewCount, images: ProductImage[], category, seller: SellerProfile, inventory?), Category (id, name, slug, icon), CartItem (id, productId, quantity, product), Order (id, orderNumber, status, total, items, createdAt), ApiResponse<T> (success, data?: T, error?: string)

Create frontend/lib/api/client.ts: export axiosClient (axios.create with baseURL from constants), add request interceptor to inject 'Authorization: Bearer ${token}' from localStorage.getItem('accessToken'), add response interceptor for 401 to redirect to /auth/login

Update frontend/app/layout.tsx: import Inter from 'next/font/google', configure font variable, add to <html className={inter.variable}>, set metadata (title: 'AgriMarket - Ethiopian Agricultural Marketplace', description)

Create frontend/app/globals.css: import Tailwind (@tailwind base/components/utilities), add CSS variables in :root for design colors, add base layer styles (body: text-textPrimary bg-background font-sans)
acceptance_criteria: Running 'npm run dev' in frontend/ starts Next.js on http://localhost:3000
Frontend builds successfully with 'npm run build' (no TypeScript or ESLint errors)
Tailwind CSS is configured with all design system colors, Inter font loads correctly
All foundation files exist with correct exports: lib/constants.ts, types/index.ts, lib/api/client.ts
app/layout.tsx renders with Inter font and correct metadata
verification: cd frontend && npm run dev (confirm server starts on localhost:3000)
npm run build (confirm successful production build)
Open http://localhost:3000 in browser (confirm default Next.js page renders with Inter font)
Inspect Tailwind config: check tailwind.config.ts has all custom colors and spacing
